title: Chapter 130 Military And Civilian Status
content:
Chapter 130 Military And Civilian Status

After a while, Ayub also came back with others.

"How was the harvest today?"

"Your Majesty, we earned a total of 3,000 military merit points today."

Just as Wang Shuo expected, with the improvement in level and equipment, the overall strength of Wang Shuo's troops has once again taken a step forward, and its efficiency has naturally become much faster.

"Okay, everyone, let's go have a rest!"

"yes!"

Wang Shuo returned to his tent, and the masons who had studied the skills also returned to their tents and continued to study.

Lying on the bed, Wang Shuo tossed and turned and couldn't sleep.

"Agui, do you have any suggestions on how to lead the people?"

"Lord, you can divide the citizens of the territory into several levels. People of different levels will be treated differently. In this way,..."

Wang Shuo interrupted him directly and differentiated the levels. Deep down in his heart, Wang Shuo still felt a little resistant to this kind of thing.

After a while, Agui continued to write: "You can also divide the people into military status and civilian status."

Wang Shuo suddenly sat up, clapped his hands, and exclaimed: "Wonderful!"

Wang Shuo plans to enroll all the citizens who have reached 100 loyalty points into the military register, all the craftsmen into the craftsmen register, and other newly joined refugees into the civil register.

At the same time, many thoughts flashed through his mind.

After a night of thinking.

Wang Shuo decided to give certain compensation to the people who had confiscated materials before, and to allow the people to own private property.

But all houses, shops, and important industries belong to the village.

Others are not very important and can be left to the people to run.

In this way, the economy can prosper very well.

Early the next morning, Wang Shuo told Duan Wenxi this idea.

"Boss, yes! This is a good idea." Duan Wenxi gave a thumbs up.

The two discussed it for another morning, perfecting the relevant details.

The specific implementation was left to Duan Wenxi.

At the same time, Duan Wenxi was promoted to the general manager of the territory, responsible for all matters of the territory.

After breakfast, Wang Shuo devoted himself to the great cause of making city wall bricks.

The process and materials for making black iron city bricks are much more complicated than making fire bricks.

The materials required include clay, iron powder, lime, and animal blood.

Wang Shuo was originally a little worried because the blood of dead beasts would solidify quickly.

But after some inspection, he found that the blood of ordinary beasts would indeed coagulate slowly, but the blood of those bosses coagulated extremely slowly.

Especially the silver boss's blood, until now, still looks like he just died.

Wang Shuo felt relieved, because the blood of a tiger was enough.

The function of animal blood is mainly to draw defensive runes, so it cannot be used too much.

At this time, the two most talented people had also understood the technology of making city wall bricks.

For those who don’t understand, let’s do this for the time being!

He asked all the masons to start getting clay near the kilns they had built yesterday.

The process of firing black iron city bricks requires that iron powder, lime, etc. be evenly mixed into the clay.

And it has to be "reconciled" repeatedly.

The air bubbles in the soil must be squeezed out as much as possible, and this is repeated repeatedly to obtain the brick embryo, which is then fired. When the bricks are out of the kiln, before they have cooled down, animal blood is used to draw defensive symbols immediately. Text, in this way, each brick can not only have a hard texture, but also have a durability of up to 10,000.

There are still two problems that Wang Shuo needs to solve now. One is a large number of iron fans, and the other is learning to draw defensive runes.
